chunks: It was only called al-Hajj al-Akbar because it was a year in which the Muslims and the polytheists performed hajj, and the polytheists did not perform hajj after that year.

key_terms.الْأَكْبَرَ: greater; denoting the distinguished or major pilgrimage in this context
key_terms.الْحَجُّ: the pilgrimage to the Sacred House
key_terms.الْمُشْرِكُونَ: the polytheists who were still present in hajj that year
key_terms.سَنَةً: a particular year being referred to

ai.seo_question: Why was the pilgrimage called al-Hajj al-Akbar?
ai.summary: This report explains why that pilgrimage was called al-Hajj al-Akbar: it was the year when both Muslims and polytheists were still present in the hajj. After that year, the polytheists no longer performed hajj, marking it as a historically significant turning point.
